name: Eyeline
summary:
Eyeline is five arcade games built on one idea: your left and right eyes don't see the same thing. The arrow on an orb, a drone's bolt or half of a Pong court may be shown to only one eye. Choose which eye leads, or play with both equal, and most games adapt to you as you play.

ORB SLICER
A blade in each hand. Orbs fly in on the beat; cut each with the blade of its colour, the way its arrow points. Five tracks, from Warm-up to Storm, and four songs.
